# segmentation_tools_pt

## Modules

- [segmentation_tools_pt.core](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/core.html.md): Shared utilities and configuration for the segmentation library: reproducible seeding, device selection, and the `SegConfig` task descriptor.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.channels](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/channels.html.md): Build a multi-channel model input from one or more single-channel source images. Generic over the number of source images and the number of output channels.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.masks](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/masks.html.md): Clean up and encode segmentation masks. Works for binary masks and for multi-category (integer-labelled) masks.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.patches](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/patches.html.md): Cut full-resolution image/mask pairs into overlapping training patches. Generic over the number of source channels and the number of mask classes.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.dataset_build](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/dataset_build.html.md): Turn a folder of full-resolution source images into a patch dataset with a reproducible train/val split and a metadata manifest.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.transforms](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/transforms.html.md): Albumentations augmentation pipelines that work for any channel count, plus per-channel normalization statistics.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.dataset](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/dataset.html.md): A generic `torch` dataset over the patch layout, hard-example sampling weights, and dataloader construction.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.losses](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/losses.html.md): Region-overlap and boundary losses for segmentation, written once and valid for binary (`C==1`, sigmoid), multi-class (`C>1`, softmax, mutually exclusive), and multilabel (`C>1`, independent sigmoid per channel, overlap allowed) heads.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.metrics](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/metrics.html.md): Pixel-level overlap metrics (per-class IoU/Dice/precision/recall) and object-level detection metrics (connected-component hit/miss/false-alarm).
- [segmentation_tools_pt.model](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/model.html.md): Build a segmentation model (any `segmentation_models_pytorch` architecture + encoder) with configurable `in_channels` and `num_classes`, plus helpers for differential learning rates and encoder freezing.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.train](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/train.html.md): One epoch of training, one epoch of validation, atomic checkpointing, and a resumable training loop with a phased loss schedule and differential learning rates.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.inference](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/inference.html.md): Turn a trained model into predictions: probability maps (optionally test-time augmented), label decoding, and an operating-threshold search for binary tasks.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.visualize](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/visualize.html.md): Look at the data and the model: verify image/mask alignment, overlay predictions on inputs, and surface the worst patches for error analysis.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.export](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/export.html.md): Export a trained model to ONNX for production deployment, with a numerical check that ONNX Runtime reproduces the PyTorch output.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.cli](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/cli.html.md): Installed console commands: `segpt-train` and `segpt-submit`.
- [segmentation_tools_pt.hydra_pipeline](https://hasangoni.github.io/segmentation_tools_pt/hydra_pipeline.html.md): Shared Hydra config helpers for `scripts/build.py` and `scripts/train.py`.
